async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Sales' link in the menubar to expand its menu
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue74b Sales").click()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Try to click 'Orders' or a similar link in the menu
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Orders").click()
    except:
        # If 'Orders' not found, try 'All Orders' or 'Manage Orders'
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="All Orders").click()
        except:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Manage Orders").click()
            except:
                # If no order-related link found, raise an error
                raise Exception("Could not find Orders link in Sales menu")
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
